component.name: Generals: Arsenal
component.summary: One launcher for Generals, Zero Hour, and future community extensions

description.p: Generals: Arsenal is an open-source fork of GeneralsX that combines the Generals and Zero Hour engine branches behind one SDL3 launcher and one window.
The package contains both open-source engine modules and no retail game assets. Users provide their legally obtained game data, which is stored under ~/.GeneralsArsenal.
